title: refactor(objectql): move 36 hand-series private docblocks out of engine.ts with the codemod's third pass (slice 1 of 2)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg1KEKUvnWZ8oYQ388cWv3dF)_

Refs #30053

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs` 加了第三遍 `--hand-docs`：手写系列（#25522 等）私有桩的 docblock 从 `engine.ts` 的类上搬到手写模块里它调用的那个函数上，替换原来的占位注释；公有 / protected 的 docblock 留在类上。本 PR 是两片中的第一片：8 个手写模块、36 块、929 行。生成物未手改。
- 为什么改：维护者在 #30012 上说「我觉得文件还是太长，还有进一步的拆分优化空间吗」「可以后续立卡处理」「合并之后再继续」。整卡约 4,100 行改动，超过 3,000 行线，所以席位定为拆两个串行 PR、不申请冻结窗口。
- 风险与回滚：只搬注释。撤销证明逐字节还原 base `engine.ts` 和 21 个手写模块；公有 `.d.ts` 相等；objectql 测试 base 550 文件 / 10,951 = head；回滚就是 revert。
- 先看：① 下方「留在类上的」表；② `engine.ts` 顶部被剪掉的 5 个 import 绑定（只被搬走的 docblock 的 `{@link}` 引用）；③ 任一手写模块头部新增的一段说明。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` 后运行 `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --hand-docs --verify --base a26abbc6`，应看到 `36 moved (929 lines) across 8 module(s)`、`13550 -> 12618 lines`，退出码 0；`--self-test` 105 例通过。
- 需要你做的：改动共 2,573 行（未超 3,000 行线），本 PR 保持草稿，按席位安排落地。第二片（其余 10 个模块，`Fixes #30053`）在本 PR 合并后从同一分支名接着开。

## What changes

- **`scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs`: a third pass, `--hand-docs`.** The hand series moved its bodies out of `engine.ts` before the codemod existed and kept every docblock on the class; each hand-module function carries the placeholder `/** The body of \`ObjectQL#x\`; the method's docblock there is its contract. */`. The codemod's own rule moves a private method's docblock with its body and keeps a public or protected one on the class. This pass applies that rule to the hand series and touches nothing else.
  - **Which stubs.** A method whose body opens with a hand marker: `[#25522 cut N]` (83), `[#27495]` (2) or the untagged `The body lives in` of `serveReferenceNames` (1). 86 in all.
  - **The move.** A private stub's docblock leaves the class and replaces its function's placeholder, one level out (the hand series re-indented every body it moved, so the functions stand at column 0). The stub's marker gains `, its docblock with it`, the phrase the codemod's own stubs use. The module's header docblock gains one paragraph saying private docblocks moved here, because each header says the docblock stays on the class.
  - **The import prune.** `noUnusedLocals` counts a JSDoc `{@link X}` as a read, so five `engine.ts` import bindings went unused once their docblocks moved: `RelatedFieldBinding`, `collectReferenceTraversals`, `optionVisibilityReadsPermissions`, `readsPermissionPredicate` and `READABLE_IDS_MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH`. The pass prunes them with the first pass's `pruneImports`. The last one was a whole `import type` that existed only for those links, so it goes with the two `//` lines directly above it (a new `dropAttachedComments` option; the first pass keeps its default and its output is unchanged).
  - **Slices.** `--modules a.ts,b.ts` moves only the named modules' stubs, and a stub already moved is skipped, so the next slice runs on this one's output.
  - **The proof.** It undoes every move in the head and in the base (each docblock back on its stub, re-indented; the placeholder back; the marker phrase and the header note out) and requires the two to be equal, `engine.ts` and each hand module byte for byte. The import prune is recomputed from the head and applied to the base, and every pruned name must be linked by a moved docblock. A base no slice touched undoes to itself, so against `main` this is "the undo rebuilds the base"; against a base an earlier slice landed in, it proves only the new slice. `--hand-docs --verify --base <ref>` re-proves a tree on disk.
  - **`--self-test`**: 105 cases in 8 batteries (was 86 in 7). The new battery "hand-series docblocks (third pass)" (floor 19) covers the verdicts, the move, the marker, the header note, determinism, slices composing, the prune, and feeds the proof what it must refuse: one character edited in a moved docblock, one edited elsewhere in a hand module, a moved docblock dropped, a staying docblock dropped, a public docblock moved, a marker over a docblock still on the class, a missing header note, a dropped binding no moved docblock links, and an unknown `--modules` name.
- **The generated slice.** `--hand-docs --modules <the 8 below> --write` on `main` `a26abbc6`, unedited (the branch merged `main` and its tree equals a fresh `--write` there).

### What moved in this slice (8 modules, 36 docblocks, 929 lines)

| Hand module | Docblocks | Lines | Before → after |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `engine-secret-internal-fields.ts` | 8 | 276 | 605 → 878 |
| `engine-master-detail-related.ts` | 4 | 184 | 512 → 697 |
| `engine-readable-ids-permission-formula.ts` | 7 | 171 | 362 → 531 |
| `engine-delete-cascade.ts` | 5 | 169 | 498 → 667 |
| `engine-execution-plumbing.ts` | 4 | 56 | 128 → 185 |
| `engine-migration-flags.ts` | 3 | 32 | 295 → 329 |
| `engine-datasource-routing.ts` | 3 | 25 | 185 → 212 |
| `engine-package-registration.ts` | 2 | 16 | 212 → 231 |

`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`: 13,550 → 12,618 lines.

### What stays on the class

| Stubs | Why |
|:--|:--|
| 20 public stubs (`validate`, `count`, `execute`, `resolveSecret`, `checkDriversHealth`, the compatibility API, …) | the docblock is the contract and stays on the facade |
| `validationMessageContext` | its function already carries a docblock with more than the placeholder (an ADR-0029 D9.2a note); merging two docblocks is an edit, not a move |
| `noteAdmittedValueShapeViolation` | it has no docblock |

### The second slice

10 modules, 28 docblocks, 858 lines: `engine-count-aggregate.ts`, `engine-driver-options.ts`, `engine-execute-transactions.ts`, `engine-file-reference-hydration.ts`, `engine-hook-dispatch.ts`, `engine-query-lowering.ts`, `engine-realtime-publish.ts`, `engine-reference-name-visible.ts`, `engine-referential-integrity.ts`, `engine-validation-messages.ts`. The plan on this head prints exactly that list (`--hand-docs` with no `--modules`), and its in-run proof against this slice passes. It opens after this PR merges and carries `Fixes #30053`.

## Verification

All at head `b09479c5` unless stated.

- **Proof.** `node scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs --hand-docs --verify --base a26abbc6`: exit 0. `36 moved (929 lines) across 8 module(s), 0 already moved at base; engine.ts 13550 -> 12618 lines; undoing every move rebuilds the base, undone the same way, for engine.ts and its 21 hand module(s) byte-for-byte, once the 5 import binding(s) only a moved docblock linked are pruned`.
- **Determinism.** The head's script, run with `--write` in a separate worktree at `a26abbc6`, writes `engine.ts` and the 8 modules byte-identical to the committed head (`cmp`, all 9), output tree sha256 `7883ed99…8ea5`.
- **`.d.ts`.** `packages/objectql/dist` built at base `a26abbc6` twice and at head twice. Base 1 = base 2 and head 1 = head 2, byte for byte. Base against head: `core` and `index` (`.d.ts` and `.d.mts`) are byte-identical; `util-HASH` has 193/193 statements and 334/334 private members, and its public surface (each class's private members removed with their docblocks) is **EQUAL**. The raw difference is the 929 lines of moved private docblocks (tsc emits a private member's docblock). Control: dropping one public docblock from the head's `.d.ts` is caught (`DIFFERS`).
- **Ablation.** Three single-line ablations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored to the HEAD blob: the per-module comparison off → "one edited character elsewhere in a hand module fails" goes red (this ablation first stayed green, which is why that case exists); the `engine.ts` comparison off → "one edited character in a moved docblock fails" and "a staying docblock dropped from the class fails" go red; the pruned-name link check off → "a binding the head dropped that no moved docblock links fails" goes red.
- **Suites.** objectql `test`: base `a26abbc6` 550 files / 10,951 passed, head 550 / 10,951. objectql `typecheck` (tsc + check:test-typecheck): exit 0.
- **Readers of these files by path.** core `second-object-read-exposure.pin.test.ts` and `row-serving-door-exposure.pin.test.ts` (7/7), types `driver-error-classification.callers.test.ts` (11/11), `check-facade-delegation-only` (OK, registry unchanged), `check:adr-anchors` (OK; `engine.ts` still names ADR-0057, ADR-0067 and ADR-0119), eslint on every changed file: exit 0.
- **Gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 72 commands, each run after a full `turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs'` (exit 0). All 72 exit 0; `--ran`: 72 derived, 72 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

## Acceptance notes

- `{@link}`s inside a moved docblock now sit in the hand module, where a name the class declares (`{@link getDriver}` and the like) resolves to the module's function of that name or to nothing. The text is unchanged by design: the pass moves bytes, it does not rewrite them. No gate reads those links.
- A changeset (`patch`, `@objectstack/objectql`) is included, as #30052's was.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes on the changed files.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. (the designated thread branch, as the Claim records; first of two slices)
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
